bends.reason: B1, lower corner of the B1/B2 joggle. Raw SIDE profile shows a clear Z-step: main panel, then a ~90 deg drop of ~35 px, then ~90 deg back into the lower piece that carries the wall and tabs. The B1 corner is bent ~90 deg and the lower piece is parallel to the main panel. Raw TOP shows the step edge-on as a dark line along B1/B2. Same direction as CAD once the scan's own-frame flip (180 deg about Y) is allowed for. Not reversed.

B2, upper corner of the joggle at the main panel edge. Raw SIDE shows the main panel turning ~90 deg into the ~35 px vertical step (rounded corner, then the step) before B1. The step goes to the same side of the main panel as the B3 flange, as in CAD. Raw TOP shows it edge-on with B1. Not reversed.

B3, full-width flange on the far edge of the main panel (the 4-hole panel). Raw SIDE shows the panel end turning ~90 deg into a ~35 px flange on the same side as the joggle step, as in CAD. Raw TOP shows the flange edge-on as a dark line along the whole top edge. Raw FRONT shows its face-on strip across the full width. Not reversed.

B4, base of the trapezoid wall. Raw SIDE shows the wall standing ~90 deg off the lower (joggled) piece, ~160 px tall, rising toward the main-panel side as in CAD. Raw FRONT shows the whole trapezoid face-on with legs, centre window and in-plane tabs. Raw TOP shows it edge-on along the B4 line, with the relief cut-outs open. Not reversed.

B5, small flange at the end of one trapezoid leg. Raw FRONT shows a dense dark edge-on bar at the far end of BOTH legs (raw-frame x~243-290 and ~519-566; the scan is mirrored in X vs CAD). Neither leg shows an in-plane extension. Raw SIDE shows the folded stub (~35 px) at the wall's far end, ~90 deg to the wall, pointing outward (away from the main panel) as in CAD. Not reversed.

B6, small flange at the end of the other trapezoid leg. Raw FRONT shows the second dense dark edge-on bar at that leg's end, with no in-plane leg extension. Raw SIDE shows the folded stub ~90 deg to the wall at its far end, pointing outward as in CAD. The wall's far end stops at the in-plane tabs (~14 px past the stub); there is no unbent flange. Not reversed.

B7, small tab folded out of the wall ~12 px above its base, through the relief cut-out (one of the two inner tabs). Raw SIDE shows a horizontal stub (~33 px) just off the lower piece, ~90 deg to the wall, pointing outward as in CAD. No unbent tongue hangs through the cut-out past the lower piece; either tab left unbent would show there. Raw ISO shows both inner tabs lying flat, and raw TOP shows both tab footprints with the relief cut-outs empty. Not reversed.

B8, the other small inner tab folded out of the wall ~12 px above its base. The same raw SIDE stub (B7 and B8 overlap in that view) points outward as in CAD, with no hanging unbent tongue. Raw ISO shows this tab flat like its twin. Raw TOP shows its footprint beyond the wall line with the relief cut-out behind it empty. Not reversed.

B9, narrow centre lip at the free end of the B3 flange. Raw SIDE shows the hook: the B3 flange turns ~90 deg back inward under the main panel as a ~45 px lip, sparser because it is narrow. Raw FRONT shows the lip edge-on as a short dark bar at the centre (x~372-432). Raw TOP shows its footprint inward of the edge through the centre cut-out, as in CAD. Not reversed.
